A.subject: Chemistry
A.text: Most stable resonating structure is
A.sol_text:
Most stable resonating structure.

The structure shown is a benzyl cation (C₆H₅CH₂⁺). In structure (1), the positive charge is on the CH₂ group attached to the benzene ring. This is the most stable resonating structure because the positive charge can be delocalized into the π-electrons of the benzene ring through resonance, forming a stabilized benzylic cation. The aromatic ring provides significant stabilization through electron donation via resonance.

In structure (2), the positive charge is on the benzene ring itself (on a ring carbon), which disrupts aromaticity.

In structure (3), the positive charge is also on the benzene ring, again disrupting the aromatic system.

Since structure (1) allows for resonance stabilization of the positive charge while maintaining aromatic character in the benzene ring, it is the most stable resonating structure.

The number of subsets of a set {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8} is equal to 2^8.
There are 2^5 subsets of {1, 2, 3, 4, 5} and 2^5 subsets of {4, 5, 6, 7, 8}, but 2^2 subsets of {4, 5} are over counted.
There are 2^5 + 2^5 − 2^2 sets that are subsets of at least one of {1, 2, 3, 4, 5} or {4, 5, 6, 7, 8}, so there are 2^8 − (2^5 + 2^5 − 2^2) subsets of {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8} that are subsets of neither {1, 2, 3, 4, 5} nor {4, 5, 6, 7, 8}
⇒ 2^8 − (2^5 + 2^5 − 2^2) = 196.

B.subject: Mathematics
B.text: Radius of the largest circle which passes through the focus of the parabola y^2 = 4x and contained in it, is
B.sol_text:
Let r be the radius of largest circle passing through the focus S(1, 0) of parabola y^2 = 4x and contained in it.
∴ Centre of circle is C ≡ (r + 1, 0)
∴ Equation of circle is [x − (r + 1)]^2 + y^2 = r^2 ... (i)
Now for points of intersection of circle (i) and parabola
y^2 = 4x, (x − r − 1)^2 + 4x = r^2
∴ x^2 + (4 − 2(r + 1))x + (2r + 1) = 0 ... (ii)
If both curves will touch each other, then discriminant of (ii) = 0
⇒ (2 − 2r)^2 − 4·1·(2r + 1) = 0
⇒ 1 + r^2 − 2r − 2r − 1 = 0
⇒ r(r − 4) = 0 ⇒ r = 4  [∵ r ≠ 0]
